6.230 rsInvalidMeDotValueInExpression
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidMeDotValueInExpression is a critical error that will occur when an expression in a child
element of a Paragraph contains the string "Me.Value".
